channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Judith and John fell in love by chance when he renovated her home; they got married and moved into a beautiful condo to live an urban lifestyle in Vancouver, but the condo life isn't giving them the family entertaining space they were each so used to; after a trip to Nova Scotia, they realized that is where they need to be, and now they are on the hunt for their forever home.
